parameters.name: ListenerIds
parameters.description: The listener IDs. You can specify up to 20 listener IDs.

parameters.name: LoadBalancerIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) instances. You can specify up to 20 instance IDs.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:

- If **NextToken** is empty, no subsequent query is performed.

- If a value is returned for **NextToken**, the value is the token that is used for the next query.

parameters.name: Skip
parameters.description: The number of entries to skip for a paged query.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags. You can specify up to 20 tags in each call.
